sourceNote: The T-pose bear mesh (assets/models/bear/README.md), with new quad faces on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist, so that no long thin faces fold under the raised forearm. tools/blender/bear_arms.py replays the Blender session that made it. Each wrist band has 5 rings, and the end of each forearm is thinner on the palm side (taper), so that the bent paw shows no dark slit.

rootNormals.note: The arm faces from 0.03 units before each wrist joint to 0.025 units past it take the normals of the skin with no crease angle in the app (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that the wrist shows no crease. With radius 0, the shoulders keep the crease angle.

paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/bear_arms.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, so that the gloss nose stays on the head and the search of the nose tip (tools/studio-body.ts) finds it.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments. Each elbow and wrist has a helper bone of this length in units, which spans the three rings of its joint in the bind. The app turns them from the joints of the pose (poseArm() of src/models/studio-rig.ts).

name: Bear

app.note: The bear keeps the size of the studio bear: the shoulder joints at 1.0 m (ANIMALS of tools/studio-body.ts). The skull top of the mesh is at 0.955 u, thus at 1.454 m. The reach is the reach of the arm factor below at that scale.

armFactorNote: The arms keep the length of the mesh, and the props fit the arms. The conductor holds no instrument.
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. The bear stands on its podium, so no seat asks for longer legs.
jointsNote: The places are in the units and the axes of the studio in the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. In the T-pose, the palm faces down and forward.

studio.note: The bear stands on its podium in the app, so the seated bind keeps the legs of the source: each turn is the identity. The trunk does not recline (open 0). The bind arms are the values of the other meshes.

armFree.note: The arm is free of the trunk beyond x 0.18 and above y 0.575. A vertex of the free arm lies beyond |x| = armSplit, within radius of the arm joints, and above the floor, which keeps the belly out.

sliver.note: The values of the other meshes.

line.note: The angle of the elephant, the rhino, and the rabbit: a lower angle mixes the weights of long arm faces.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the knee to 1 at the thigh joint, so that the round haunch stays on the hips.

weights.note: Beyond the plane of armSplit (armFree), only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom, each vertex follows the head only. Each round ear follows its ear bone above earBase. The short tail is a ball on one bone (tailBall).
weights.rigidPaintedNote: The corners of each thin face at these points take the mean of their painted weights (rigid_faces() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, after the painted weights). The points are the middles of four faces at the front of the left shoulder bridge, which fold in the play (pnpm fold-probe conductor --faces).

flip.note: The values of the other meshes.

check.note: The values of the other meshes.

tone.note: The brown fur takes the darker brown of orchestra-latest.png. Only the toes keep their colors (keep), because the Blender weights put the top of each paw on the fingers bone. The claws are darker than the first point, so the tone does not move them.

colors.note: The values of samples, palette, eyeShare, and dark are the values of the first bear mesh.

eyeShell.note: The values of the other meshes.

chair.note: The chair of the rig sets the seat top of the seated bind. The bear stands in the app, so no player sits on this seat.

crease.note: The values of the other meshes.

raise.note: The shape of the bent left wrist of the conductor (pnpm raise-fit conductor --faces 1587,1586,2532 --side L --bone hand on the rig with the wrist rings and the taper of bear_arms.py). In the pose of the rule, 40 rounds of taubin() smooth the skin by its weight on the wrist helper, so that the inner side of the bend shows a soft crease and no dark line. The right wrist needs no shape: its deeper taper keeps it smooth.
